يتدافعون (form VI)
# يَتَدَافَعُونَ (yatadāfaʕūna) /ja.ta.daː.fa.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
# يُتَدَافَعُونَ (yutadāfaʕūna) /ju.ta.daː.fa.ʕuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَدَافَعَ (tadāfaʕa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
